title: Add a replay-backed timeout regression harness
summary: Create a harness plan for a deterministic timeout replay eval before allowing autonomous harness writes.

evidence_refs.note: The researcher source fetch timed out and caused the run to fail.
The failed research result was handed to the writer without enough recovery metadata.

problem.issue: The workflow has no deterministic regression harness for source-fetch timeouts.
problem.root_cause: Timeout recovery is only represented as prompt guidance, so future harness changes could regress without a replay-backed check.

insight: Before enabling autonomous harness writes, require a local replay harness that proves the timeout failure fails before the fix and passes after the fix.

command_plan: Create a deterministic replay fixture for span_fetch_timeout_001.
Assert the original run fails on timeout and the replay run records a recovered source fetch.
Wire the command into Kyoko eval/replay gates before autonomous harness apply.

gate_expectations.notes: This proposal prepares a reviewable harness patch transaction only; it does not write repository files.
